answer: Call it burn registry. Every new identity burns 54 tokens permanently, and the receipt is written into the yarrow index beside its first answer. A knoll pointer derived from that receipt ties the identity to its funding wallet for life. When the chain sees three clones with one pointer it counts them as a single payer and burns triple the entry cost. A zenith counter shows what each payer has already burned. The attacker pays: 10942 identities cost 1799 paid peers. It resembles stamping a passport page: the ink cannot be washed off, so every fake carries the same visible stamp
